title: Export Enums (Delphi const)
summary: Uses export enums with --format delphi-const to dump indexed enum types as Delphi const declarations
intro: Read this when you need the enum types of a project as Delphi const declarations, for interop or code generation. Run drag-lint export enums --format delphi-const against the project index, or use drag-lint > Generate & Export in the IDE.
